commit.subject: LU-18041 lustre: centralize NID-based UUID format
commit.message:
LU-18041 lustre: centralize NID-based UUID format

Introduce helpers to convert NIDs to UUID strings
and switch existing call sites to use them. This
removes open-coded uses of libcfs_nidstr_r() for
UUID generation.

No functional changes.
